exposure: Levels of cell-free pregnancy-associated placenta-specific microRNAs (miRNAs) in maternal plasma
outcome: Plasma concentrations of cell-free miR-517a and miR-518b
cohort: 20 singleton pregnancies with placenta previa (placenta previa group) and 26 uncomplicated pregnancies (control group)
finding: Plasma concentrations of cell-free miR-517a and miR-518b at 32 weeks of gestation were altered in pregnant women with placenta previa, and the circulating level of cell-free miR-517a in placenta previa may be a predictive marker for the risks of alert bleeding later and massive hemorrhage at delivery.
